files.t: Semilinear sets are closed under intersection, set difference and complement
files.s: This file proves that the semilinear sets in any commutative monoid are closed under intersection and set difference. They are also closed under complement if the monoid is finitely generated. We prove these results on `ℕ ^ k` first (which are private APIs in this file) and then generalize to any commutative monoid.
